riskAnalysis: R02 closed all four R01 findings and identified two residual medium blockers: the shared raw path validator accepted repeated separators, and the real append fixture constructed an incoherent recovery projection when its source was frozen in REVIEW. The remediation rejects every raw spelling that differs from its canonical PurePosix representation before resolution or access, adds double-separator denial at recovery-evidence, recovery-ledger, and appended-amendment command boundaries, and makes the executable Git fixture derive its approved recovery state from CHANGES_REQUESTED, BLOCKED, REVIEW, or APPROVED source projections without rewriting prior attempts. Because the changes affect shared governance controls, the exact 108-test focused suite and all 118 governed-file quality checks were run at candidate d4d877966e44327eaa1d0b1219836d1413fcb7e2, with authority, review-site, generated-view, and diff validators also passing.
